steps.text:
SELECT o1_0.id, o1_0.address, o1_0.city, o1_0.first_name, o1_0.last_name, p1_0.owner_id, p1_0.id, p1_0.birth_date, p1_0.name, t1_0.id, t1_0.name, v1_0.pet_id, v1_0.id, v1_0.visit_date, v1_0.description, v1_0.visit_time, o1_0.telephone
FROM owners o1_0
LEFT JOIN pets p1_0
ON o1_0.id=p1_0.owner_id
LEFT JOIN types t1_0
ON t1_0.id=p1_0.type_id
LEFT JOIN visits v1_0
ON p1_0.id=v1_0.pet_id
WHERE o1_0.id in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
